premises.text: Consumer shopping data is one-sided today in favor of vendors
Email-forwarded receipts and store plugins feed purchases into a consumer-owned history
premises.evidence_span: forward my order confirmations in my inbox

premises.text: Annotating purchases with needs and stories enables taste signaling and mindful shopping
premises.evidence_span: What we're doing here as we're posting what we're buying and what we talk about when we're buying is taste signaling

premises.text: Shopify compatibility connects tens of thousands of merchant stores
premises.evidence_span: instantly data compatible with tens of thousands of stores

premises.text: Selective sharing of history with chosen brands returns personalized results and deals
premises.evidence_span: I can choose what part of my data, how far back in my data that I'm sharing. with the stores in order for them to give me really cool personalized results

value.text: Consumers gain vendor-like leverage from their own shopping data
value.evidence_span: consumers had as much leverage with the data as the vendors do

causal_links.evidence_span: There's definitely something wrong with this picture
make their shopping data more meaningful

notes: Analytics mashup (weather) treated as planned feature of enrichment, not a separate premise. Retailer 'powered by' interest treated as GTM evidence not a premise.
